Promote a candidate tuning run into the tracked tables

Source: R/tune_promote.R
knw_tune_promote.Rd

scripts/0320 writes a full run to data/tune/candidate/<run>/ and scripts/0330 compares it into data/compare/candidate/<run>/, both ignored, so iterating changes nothing tracked (#111). Promotion, on the operator's word, moves the run in: every file of each promoted key (its tables, the grade tables' records, and the ignored grades, curve, score cache, segments and GeoPackage), its Atlas-gradient sensitivity, the run's logs, its figures, and its rows of the tables that hold every key (compare.csv, change.csv, checks.csv, floodplain.csv). A key's files are moved, not copied (its grades and GeoPackage run to gigabytes), so a promoted key leaves the run's directory; the logs are copied. A tracked file of a promoted key that the run did not write is removed, so no key is left half one run and half another. Every file replaced or removed is first moved to candidate/replaced_<stamp>/ under the two directories, itself a candidate, so a promotion is undone by promoting that (the logs it added, and files it added where none stood, then stay).

Usage

knw_tune_promote(
  run,
  keys = NULL,
  live = NULL,
  tune_dir = "data/tune",
  compare_dir = "data/compare",
  log_dir = "scripts/logs/habitat",
  fig_dir = "research/fig",
  dry_run = FALSE
)

Arguments

run

character(1) the candidate run's name.

keys

NULL for every key of the run, or the keys to promote ("CH_rear").

live

NULL, or a named list of the values the promoted set must carry to pass what reads it next (evidence_md5: the md5s of this machine's derived tables; walk_md5: this tree's walk; discharge_load: the live flow load); scripts/0335 passes them.

tune_dir, compare_dir

the tracked directories; the candidates are their candidate/<run>/.

log_dir

where the tracked logs live.

fig_dir

where the tracked comparison figures live.

dry_run

TRUE checks and lists, moving and writing nothing.

Value

A list: keys, written (tracked paths written), removed (tracked paths removed), archive (the replaced_<stamp> run holding what was replaced, NA when nothing was), and notes (what the run did not bring and was left as it was), invisibly.

Details

Keys can be promoted alone, but only onto the build the kept keys are on: scripts/0325 and the article bundles require one evidence build, link run, gradient, reference edges, flow load, walk, link config and tuned structure across every key, so a promotion that would leave two is refused before anything moves, naming the field and the kept keys that would have to come along. After a change upstream (a new link run or evidence build) that means every fitted key moves together. Each promoted key's grades must carry their record (knw_grade_record_write()) and match it (md5 and size; a replaced_* archive may lack one), and kept keys are read from their records where the tables are absent. Each promoted key's grades must be of its recommended rule on its own evidence, and its comparison of the same rule and made after its grades.

Examples

d <- tempfile(); dir.create(c <- file.path(d, "tune", "candidate", "r1"), recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(file.path(d, "compare"))
utils::write.csv(data.frame(species_code = "KO", stage = "rear", status = "no_stream_rule"),
                 file.path(c, "KO_rear_summary.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
p <- knw_tune_promote("r1", tune_dir = file.path(d, "tune"), compare_dir = file.path(d, "compare"),
                      log_dir = file.path(d, "logs"), fig_dir = file.path(d, "fig"))
basename(p$written)
#> [1] "KO_rear_summary.csv"
